thread:
sabine: Scheduling the midnight deploy for model-routing v3 at 00:30 UTC. Change window starts 00:15. Feature flag plan below, please ack.

sabine: FF plan: enable "model_route_v3" pinned=false; ramp: 1% -> 10% (30m) -> 50% (1h) -> 100% (3h). If latency P95 > 400ms or error rate spike > 0.5% during any step, rollback to previous flag value and pin to v2.

jamal: ack. I'll watch SLOs. Who's oncall for infra? @megan_oncall?

megan_oncall: I'm oncall. I'll watch the deploy channel + paging. Set alert for p95>350ms so we get early warning.

deploy-bot: deploy requested by sabine. Command: /deploy start model-routing-v3 --change-window=00:15-03:30 --ff=model_route_v3 --ramp=1,10,50,100

arjun: note: we'll pin model binary to v3.0.2 in the canary group only; global pin only if we decide to cutover. I'll push a release note in the changelog after canary green.

katie: product wants a hard rollback threshold: if rerank quality drops on cohort A by >2% based on smoke prompts, rollback immediately.

leo-ops: put a temporary kill-switch FF (model_route_v3_force_off) in the top-level config. If anything untoward, we can flip that to zero and abort the rollout.

canary-monitor-bot: Canary metrics stream: latency_p95=320ms, error_rate=0.03%, model_comp_time=110ms. Will post 5m aggregates to thread.

jamal: small nit: make sure deploy-bot is configured to honor the force_off flag and not continue if set. Also add a drain window for prefix cache eviction when we shift routes.

sabine: agreed. plan: start 1% at 00:30, hold 30m, check metrics + smoke set, then step to 10% if green. If anything fails, deploy-bot will auto-drain and pin back to v2. I'll push a short release note: "model-routing v3 staged roll: gradual ramp, rollback criteria, pinback plan." Anyone object?

katie: no objections. :thumbsup:

megan_oncall: oncall will escalate to infra at p95>400ms or >0.5% errors. Otherwise we wait for 3h soak before full cut.

arjun: /note command posted: curl to flip FF: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/switch-flag \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"flag":"model_route_v3","percent":10}'
```

deploy-bot: acknowledged. Scheduled canary at 00:30 UTC. I will post status updates and final result here.

canary-monitor-bot: next report in 5m.

sabine: thanks team. I'll be online during the window. ping me if anything. sabine out.
